G300.def: of Hebrew origin («0526»); Amon, an Israelite:--Amon.

G301.def: of Hebrew origin («0531»); Amos, an Israelite:--Amos.

G302.pos: 1. has no exact English equivalent, see definitions under AV
G302.def: a primary particle, denoting a supposition, wish, possibility or uncertainty:--(what-, where-, wither-, who-)soever. Usually unexpressed except by the subjunctive or potential mood. Also contracted for «1437».

G303.def: a primary preposition and adverb; properly, up; but (by extension) used (distributively) severally, or (locally) at (etc.):--and, apiece, by, each, every (man), in, through. In compounds (as a prefix) it often means (by implication) repetition, intensity, reversal, etc.

G305.def: from «303» and the base of «939»; to go up (literally or figuratively):--arise, ascend (up), climb (go, grow, rise, spring) up, come (up).

G306.def: middle voice from «303» and «906»; to put off (for oneself):--defer.

G307.et: from (303) and a derivative of the base of (939)
G307.def: from «303» and a derivative of the base of «939»; to cause to go up, i.e. haul (a net):--draw.

G308.def: from «303» and «991»; to look up; by implication, to recover sight:--look (up), see, receive sight.

G309.def: from «308»; restoration of sight:--recovery of sight.

G312.def: from «303» and the base of «32»; to announce (in detail):--declare, rehearse, report, show, speak, tell.

G313.def: from «303» and «1080»; to beget or (by extension) bear (again):--beget, (bear) × (again).

G314.def: from «303» and «1097»; to know again, i.e. (by extension) to read:--read.

G316.def: from «318»; necessary; by implication, close (of kin):--near, necessary, necessity, needful.

G317.def: adverb from a derivative of «315»; compulsorily:--by constraint.

G318.def: from «303» and the base of «43»; constraint (literally or figuratively); by implication, distress:--distress, must needs, (of) necessity(-sary), needeth, needful.

G319.def: middle voice from «303» and «1107»; to make (oneself) known:--be made known.

G321.def: from «303» and «71»; to lead up; by extension to bring out; specially, to sail away:--bring (again, forth, up again), depart, launch (forth), lead (up), loose, offer, sail, set forth, take up.

G322.def: from «303» and «1166»; to exhibit, i.e. (by implication) to indicate, appoint:--appoint, shew.

G324.def: from «303» and «1209»; to entertain (as a guest):--receive.

G326.def: to recover life (literally or figuratively):--(be a-)live again, revive.

G328.def: from «303» and «2224»; to gird afresh:--gird up.

G329.et: from (303) and a compound of the base of (2226) and (4442)
G329.def: from «303» and a compound of the base of «2226» and «4442»; to re-enkindle:--stir up.

G330.def: from «303» and thallo (to flourish); to revive:--flourish again.

G331.def: from «394»; a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person):--accused, anathema, curse, × great.

G332.def: from «331»; to declare or vow under penalty of execration:--(bind under a) curse, bind with an oath.

G333.def: from «303» and «2334»; to look again (i.e. attentively) at (literally or figuratively):--behold, consider.

G334.et: from (394) [like (331), but in a good sense]
G334.def: from «394» (like «331», but in a good sense); a votive offering:--gift.

G335.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle [cf (427)]) and (127)
G335.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle (compare «427»)) and «127»; impudence, i.e. (by implication) importunity:--importunity.

G337.def: from «303» and (the active of) «138»; to take up, i.e. adopt; by implication, to take away (violently), i.e. abolish, murder:--put to death, kill, slay, take away, take up.

G338.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and (159) (in the sense of (156))
G338.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «159» (in the sense of «156»); innocent:--blameless, guiltless.

G339.def: from «303» and «2523»; properly, to set up, i.e. (reflexively) to sit up:--sit up.

G340.def: from «303» and a derivative of «2537»; to restore:--renew.

G341.def: from «303» and a derivative of «2537»; to renovate:--renew.

G343.et: from (303) (in the sense of reversal) and (2572)
G343.def: from «303» (in the sense of reversal) and «2572»; to unveil:--open, (un-)taken away.

G345.def: from «303» and «2749»; to recline (as a corpse or at a meal):--guest, lean, lie, sit (down, at meat), at the table.

G346.def: from «303» and «2775» (in its original sense); to sum up:--briefly comprehend, gather together in one.

G347.def: from «303» and «2827»; to lean back:--lay, (make) sit down.

G348.def: from «303» and «2875»; to beat back, i.e. check:--hinder.

G349.def: from «303» and «2896»; to scream up (aloud):--cry out.

G350.def: from «303» and «2919»; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. (by implication) investigate, interrogate, determine:--ask, question, discern, examine, judge, search.

G352.et: from (303) (in the sense of reversal) and (2955)
G352.def: from «303» (in the sense of reversal) and «2955»; to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated:--lift up, look up.

G353.def: from «303» and «2983»; to take up:--receive up, take (in, unto, up).

G355.et: from (303) and a form of the alternate of (138)
G355.def: from «303» and a form of the alternate of «138»; properly, to use up, i.e. destroy:--consume.

G356.def: from a compound of «303» and «3056»; proportion:--proportion.

G357.def: middle voice from «356»; to estimate, i.e. (figuratively) contemplate:--consider.

G358.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «251»; saltless, i.e. insipid:--X lose saltness.

G360.def: from «303» and «3089»; to break up, i.e. depart (literally or figuratively):--depart, return.

G361.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (264)
G361.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «264»; sinless:--that is without sin.

G363.def: from «303» and «3403»; to remind; (reflexively) to recollect:--call to mind, (bring to , call to, put in), remember(-brance).

G365.def: from «303» and a derivative of «3501»; to renovate, i.e. reform:--renew.

G366.def: from «303» and «3525»; to become sober again, i.e. (figuratively) regain (one's) senses:--recover self.

G367.def: of Hebrew origin («02608»); Ananias, the name of three Israelites:--Ananias.

G368.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of (473) and (4483)
G368.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of «473» and «4483»; indisputable:--cannot be spoken against.

G370.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «514»; unfit:--unworthy.

G373.def: from «303» and «3973»; (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh:--take ease, refresh, (give, take) rest.

G375.def: from «303» and «3992»; to send up or back:--send (again).

G376.et: from (303) (in the sense of intensity) and peros (maimed)
G376.def: from «303» (in the sense of intensity) and peros (maimed); crippled:--maimed.

G377.def: from «303» and «4098»; to fall back, i.e. lie down, lean back:--lean, sit down (to meat).

G378.def: from «303» and «4137»; to complete; by implication, to occupy, supply; figuratively, to accomplish (by coincidence ot obedience):--fill up, fulfill, occupy, supply.

G379.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (626)
G379.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «626»; indefensible:--without an excuse, inexcusable.

G380.et: from (303) (in the sense of reversal) and (4428)
G380.def: from «303» (in the sense of reversal) and «4428»; to unroll (a scroll or volume):--open.

G382.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (705)
G382.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «705»; unnumbered, i.e. without number:--innumerable.

G383.def: from «303» and «4579»; figuratively, to excite:--move, stir up.

G384.et: from (303) (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of (4632)
G384.def: from «303» (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of «4632»; properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset:--subvert.

G385.def: from «303» and «4685»; to take up or extricate:--draw up, pull out.

G386.def: from «450»; a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth):--raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again.

G387.et: from a derivative of (450) (in the sense of removal)
G387.def: from a derivative of «450» (in the sense of removal); properly, to drive out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively):--trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar.

G389.def: from «303» and «4727»; to sigh deeply:--sigh deeply.

G390.def: from «303» and «4762»; to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. remain, live:--abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used.

G392.et: from (303) and the middle voice of (5021)
G392.def: from «303» and the middle voice of «5021»; to arrange:--set in order.

G393.def: from «303» and the base of «5056»; to (cause to) arise:--(a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up.

G394.et: from (303) and the middle voice of (5087)
G394.def: from «303» and the middle voice of «5087»; to set forth (for oneself), i.e propound:--communicate, declare.

G395.def: from «393»; a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication, the east (also in plural):--dayspring, east, rising.

G396.def: from «303» and the base of «5157»; to overturn (figuratively):--overthrow, subvert.

G397.def: from «303» and «5142»; to rear (physically or mentally):--bring up, nourish (up).

G398.def: from «303» and «5316»; to show, i.e. (reflexively) appear, or (passively) to have pointed out:--(should) appear, discover.

G399.def: from «303» and «5342»; to take up (literally or figuratively):--bear, bring (carry, lead) up, offer (up).
